claim: Brain scanning clarifies specialized neural regions
originalWording: Brain scanning clarifies specialized neural regions

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Brain scanning makes significant progress in identifying specialized regions and computational organization.
reference.rationale: The 2016 human cortical map identified 180 areas per hemisphere, a concrete regional reverse-engineering advance. Whole-animal connectomes and cell atlases add substantial progress. This modest forecast does not require a complete human emulation.

evidence.title: Glasser et al.: A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex
evidence.note: 180 cortical areas per hemisphere; direct evidence of improved regional brain understanding, not whole-brain functional reconstruction.. 180 cortical areas per hemisphere; direct evidence of improved regional brain understanding, not whole-brain functional reconstruction.

strict.criterion: Scanning yields understood algorithms for the major regions and those algorithms demonstrably drive machine neural-network design.
strict.rationale: Regional mapping is strong; the complete algorithm-understanding and causal transfer-to-AI chain is less established.
